title: ShieldCare Late Fee: Which Unpaid Periods Are Counted
content:
## The counting rule

On a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan held on instalments, the periods counted toward the fee
are taken as follows. Two things are read from the plan's premium history: the number of premium
payments standing on the plan in the last 12 months, and whether the most recent premium period
billed is still inside the plan's grace days, which it is while fewer days have passed since the
first day of that period than the plan's grace days allow.

| What the plan's history shows | The periods counted toward the fee |
| --- | --- |
| at least 3 premium payments in the last 12 months, and the most recent period billed still inside the plan's grace days | the unpaid periods whose grace has fully run, which is the unpaid periods less the most recent one and never fewer than 1 |
| the most recent period billed still inside the plan's grace days, and fewer than 3 premium payments in the last 12 months | the oldest unpaid period alone |
| every other plan | every unpaid period counts toward the fee |

## Both sides of each condition

Exactly 3 premium payments in the last 12 months satisfies the first row; 2 payments does not, and
falls to the second row so long as the most recent period billed is still inside grace. Where the
days elapsed since the first day of the most recent period billed have reached the plan's grace
days, that period is no longer inside grace and neither of the first two rows is reached, so every
unpaid period counts.

## The counting worked through on hypothetical figures

| Unpaid periods on the plan | Payments in the last 12 months | Most recent period billed | Periods counted |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6 | 5 | grace already run | 6 |
| 6 | 2 | grace already run | 6 |
| 6 | 2 | still inside grace | 1 |
| 6 | 5 | still inside grace | 5 |
| 1 | 5 | still inside grace | 1 |

The last line shows the floor at work: taking the most recent period off a single unpaid period
would leave none, and the count is never fewer than 1.
